reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute ticket volume has roughly doubled since August (610→1260/month, E-05), driven mainly by disputes on bills calculated from ACTUAL meter reads (59% of disputes, E-02) rather than estimated-read substitution, pointing to an error introduced in the billing import/validation step around August (candidate: a validation rule change, H-RULE-CHANGE-ERROR) as the primary mechanism. Tariff rates did not change (E-01, E-06) and response times remain within SLA (E-04), ruling those out; a secondary, smaller contribution comes from field route completion falling to 88% against a 95% target (E-03), driving the minority of disputes tied to estimated reads.
